beats.say: Ella Langley and Morgan Wallen released their first collaboration on 24 April 2026.
The song is titled I Can't Love You Anymore.
It was released through Sawgod and Columbia.
The track appears on the reissue of Langley's second studio album, Dandelion.
Langley first performed with Wallen in June 2025 on his I'm the Problem tour.
